title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Chatticus
description:
**Problem**
Low-priority findings from the 2026-10-20 audit of Chatticus and chattic.us (the Chattic.us-web findings are included here).

- [ ] Blog typescript-and-durable-sessions.md:25 says "Staging and production still run Python"; check and update the tense.
- [ ] Broken links: drdobbs.com no longer resolves (DNS); anth.us/blog/* links redirect to /articles.
- [ ] Use https:// links instead of http://; dev.chattic.us vs develop.chattic.us naming is inconsistent across docs.
- [ ] README mentions/ships an unused docker-compose.yml; remove it or document it.

**Evidence**
- typescript-and-durable-sessions.md:25 "Staging and production still run Python".
- drdobbs.com: DNS failure during the 213-page crawl of chattic.us; anth.us/blog/* returns a redirect to /articles.
- http:// links found in docs; dev.chattic.us and develop.chattic.us both used.
- docker-compose.yml at repo root, unused.

**Fix**
Fix each checklist item; tick them off as they land.

**How to verify**
Each checklist item is ticked, and a re-crawl of https://chattic.us finds no broken links.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
